MY.note: Sold in Malaysia, but no launch price was found in Malaysian launch coverage.

rear_detail: 8 MP Ultra Wide Marco Camera (f/2.2 aperture)
front_detail: 60 MP Ultra Wide Portrait Camera (f/2.4 aperture)

connectivity.wifi: 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz, 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax, 2 × 2 MIMO, HE160, 4096 QAM, 8 Spatial-stream Sounding MU-MIMO.
connectivity.bluetooth: Bluetooth 5.2, Support BLE, SBC, AAC, LDAC.
connectivity.positioning: GPS (L1 + L5 Dual band)/AGPS/GLONASS/BeiDou (B1I + B1C + B2a Tri-band)/GALILEO (E1 + E5a Dual band)/QZSS (L1 + L5 Dual band)

specs.sensors: Gravity Sensor, Fingerprint Sensor, Gyroscope, Compass, Ambient Light Sensor, Laser Sensor, Colour Temprature Sensor
